# verda settings

> Verda CLI **v1.10.0** · [other versions](https://github.com/verda-cloud/verda-cli/tags)

Manage CLI settings

View and update CLI settings stored in ~/.verda/config.yaml.

Subcommands:

- [`verda settings theme`](#verda-settings-theme): View or change the CLI color theme

## verda settings theme

View or change the CLI color theme

View and change the CLI color theme.

Without arguments, opens an interactive theme selector.
With a theme name, sets it directly.

**Usage**

```text
verda settings theme [name] [flags]
```

**Examples**

```bash
# Interactive selection
verda settings theme

# Set a theme directly
verda settings theme dracula
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
